name: conversation-atlas
description: A live side pane that maps a long Claude Code session: goal, current path, possible detours, decisions, open questions, checkpoints, working files and what to resume next. It observes on its own and asks before changing your intent.

observer.title: Observer
observer.description: claude and engine: Claude reports topic shifts, decisions and questions through a small tool (a few tokens per changed turn) besides the free engine events. engine only: files, activity, tests, commits and your own wording only; no observer rules or recorded Claude observations. First-run setup asks before the stored choice takes effect.

scanOnLaunch.title: Map earlier conversation on launch
scanOnLaunch.description: When Atlas joins a session that already has history: engine replays it for free (prompts, files, tests, commits, questions); claude also asks Claude once to map topics and decisions (one forked request, mostly served from the prompt cache); off does neither. /atlas scan always works.
